body_text:
Hi Alex,

Thank you again for your interest in the Software Engineer II role at Postman. After careful consideration, we have decided to move forward with other candidates whose experience more closely matches our current needs, so we will not be proceeding with your application.

We wish you the best in your search.

Postman Recruiting
